dynare.serverPath.description: Absolute path to a Dygnosis executable. Empty uses the binary included with the extension. Set only in user/machine settings.

dynare.diff.layout.description: Layout of Before and After expression panels. Auto stacks them in a narrow view. Field tables keep their Before and After columns. Defaults use the model that opened Changes.
